title: Counit compatibility of nested open-cover mates
statement: The displayed nested adjunction mates compose with their respective counits to the intersection counit.

proof.text: Apply the adjunction hom-equivalence to both sides. Naturality of the restriction comparison isomorphism, the right triangle identity, and the unit-counit triangle identity reduce each equation to reflexivity.

proof_origin.note: Proved directly by adjunction hom-equivalence naturality and triangle identities.

lean.statement: theorem open_cover_mate_module_counit_compatibility (X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.{u}) (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u}) (_hR : R = (sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf) (U V : Opens X) (_hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) [(overFunctor.{u} R U).Additive] [(overFunctor.{u} R V).Additive] [(overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V)).Additive] (SU : SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over U) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} R) (SV : SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over V) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} R) (SW : SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over (U ⊓ V)) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} R) [SU.Additive] [SV.Additive] [SW.Additive] (aU : SU ⊣ overFunctor.{u} R U) (aV : SV ⊣ overFunctor.{u} R V) (aW : SW ⊣ overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V)) (F : SheafOfModules.{u} R) : let cU := overFunctorMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ⟶ U) let cV := overFunctorMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ⟶ V) let iU := (aW.homEquiv _ _).symm (cU.inv.app F ≫ (overMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ⟶ U)).map (aU.unit.app ((overFunctor.{u} R U).obj F)) ≫ cU.hom.app (SU.obj ((overFunctor.{u} R U).obj F))) let iV := (aW.homEquiv _ _).symm (cV.inv.app F ≫ (overMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ⟶ V)).map (aV.unit.app ((overFunctor.{u} R V).obj F)) ≫ cV.hom.app (SV.obj ((overFunctor.{u} R V).obj F))) iU ≫ aU.counit.app F = aW.counit.app F ∧ iV ≫ aV.counit.app F = aW.counit.app F
